README example: a planner drafts, a reviewer from another model family gives feedback, the planner revises, and the reviewer's model executes the revised plan, as one typed sequence at target 2.35. Compile and dry-run evidence only; no live provider run is recorded.

File-based variant of the README example: the planner drafts artifacts/design/<slug>.md and returns its typed path, the reviewer reads the draft through a :doc fill, the planner writes the final docs/design/<slug>.md as a new file so the review's input never changes and resume can retry any step, and the reviewer's model executes the final document, at target 2.35. Compile and dry-run evidence only; no live provider run is recorded.
